_comment: Advisories the CI npm audit gate may ignore. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI again. An allowlisted advisory that reaches production dependencies always fails. See .github/scripts/npm_audit_gate.mjs.

advisories.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <= 4.0.7 with no patched release yet. Reached only through developer tooling (typescript-eslint, eslint-config-next, tailwindcss build) on project-controlled glob patterns; not in production dependencies of either web app.
